name: Tax Efficient Product Type 2 Code
definition: Specifies a type of tax efficient product.

CASH.name: Cash
CASH.definition: Cash individual savings account. In the UK, this is known as a cash ISA.

CLIS.name: Cash LISA
CLIS.definition: Cash lifetime individual savings account. In the UK, this is known as a cash LISA.

FISA.name: Flexible
FISA.definition: Flexible individual savings account. In the UK, this is known as a FISA.

GISK.name: General Investment Savings Account
GISK.definition: General investment savings account. (Known as Investeringssparkonto (ISK) in some markets.)

GASK.name: General Share Savings Account
GASK.definition: General shares or equity savings account. (Known as ASK in some markets.)

HISA.name: Help To Buy
HISA.definition: Help to buy individual savings account. In the UK, this is known as a HISA.

INNF.name: Innovative Finance
INNF.definition: Innovative finance individual savings account. In the UK, this is known as an innovative ISA.

JCSH.name: Junior Cash
JCSH.definition: Junior cash individual savings account. In the UK, this is known as a cash JISA.

JISA.name: Junior Stocks And Shares ISA
JISA.definition: Junior stocks and shares individual savings account. In the UK, this is known as a stocks and shares  JISA.

LISA.name: Lifetime
LISA.definition: Stocks and shares lifetime individual savings account. In the UK, this is known as a stocks and shares LISA.

CCTF.name: Non Stakeholder Child Trust Fund
CCTF.definition: Non-stakeholder child trust fund individual savings account. In the UK, this is known as a non-stakeholder CTF ISA.

SCTF.name: Stakeholder Child Trust Fund
SCTF.definition: Stakeholder child trust fund individual savings account. In the UK, this is known as a stakeholder CTF ISA.

EQUI.name: Stocks And Shares
EQUI.definition: Stocks and shares individual savings account. In the UK, this is known as a stocks and shares ISA.
